landing.hero_desc: Real-time email protection for your domain. Cloudflare-native, GDPR-compliant, live in 2 minutes.
landing.features_title: Everything your domain needs to stay safe.
landing.features_desc: Automated threat filtering, secure quarantine, and on-demand DNS audits.
landing.feat_ai_desc: Every incoming email classified instantly. Verdicts you can review and override in one click.
landing.feat_remediation_desc: Suspicious emails held safely. Restore or delete whenever you decide.
landing.feat_dns_desc: Check SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and the TLS certificate from one screen.
landing.integration_desc: Connect via Cloudflare Email Routing. No migration, no mailbox changes.
landing.integration_step_1_desc: Encrypted in transit. Never stored in plain text.
landing.integration_step_2_desc: Sicurre discovers your DNS zones and sets up routing automatically.
landing.integration_step_3_desc: SPF, DKIM, and DMARC verified and corrected automatically.
landing.integration_step_4_desc: Every email is scanned and suspicious messages follow your quarantine rules.
landing.testimonial_text: Sicurre blocked 3 targeted phishing attempts in the first week. Up and running in 10 minutes.
landing.cta_section_desc: Connect your domain and be protected in minutes.
